FAQ’s

Q1: How quickly can I deploy an AI avatar for my business?

A: You can launch your personalized AI avatar in just 3–7 business days. Our expert team ensures quick setup while tailoring the avatar exactly to your brand’s style and needs.

Q2: Can the avatars integrate with my website and mobile app?

A: Absolutely! Our avatars easily integrate with your website, mobile apps, kiosks, and even chat platforms. We ensure seamless functionality across all digital touchpoints to enhance user engagement.

Q3: Will my avatar sound robotic or artificial?

A: Not at all! Our avatars use emotion-based AI and natural speech synthesis technology, making conversations feel human, warm, and authentic—never robotic or stiff.

Q4: How many languages does the system support?

A: Our Interactive AI Avatars are fluent in over 175 languages. They can switch languages effortlessly, making global communication smoother, more inclusive, and far more engaging for everyone.

Q5: Can I customize the look and voice of the avatar?

A: Yes, 100%! Customize your avatar’s appearance, clothing, voice tone, accent, speaking style, and even personality traits to match your brand identity perfectly and uniquely.
